html:
G'oya

Kogorta tahlilining asosi: har bir abonent uchun bitta savol, "keyingi oyda faol bo'lganmi". Avval qo'ng'iroqlardan (abonent, oy) juftlarini takrorsiz yig'amiz, faqat javob berilgan qo'ng'iroqlar bo'yicha. Keyin abonentni o'zi ulangan oydan keyingi oy bilan LEFT JOIN qilamiz. Juftlar takrorsiz bo'lgani uchun har abonentga ko'pi bilan bitta qator to'g'ri keladi, va COUNT(a.subscriber_id) qolganlar sonini beradi.

Yechim

Faqat PostgreSQLWITH active AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT subscriber_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', call_date) AS m
  FROM calls
  WHERE duration_sec > 0
)
SELECT TO_CHAR(s.joined_on, 'YYYY-MM') AS cohort,
       COUNT(*) AS subscribers,
       COUNT(a.subscriber_id) AS retained,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(a.subscriber_id) / COUNT(*), 1) AS retention_pct
FROM subscribers s
LEFT JOIN active a
  ON a.subscriber_id = s.id
 AND a.m = DATE_TRUNC('month', s.joined_on) + INTERVAL '1 month'
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(s.joined_on, 'YYYY-MM')
ORDER BY cohort

SQLite'da oy boshi date(d, 'start of month'), keyingi oy boshi date(d, 'start of month', '+1 month'):

Faqat SQLiteWITH active AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT subscriber_id, date(call_date, 'start of month') AS m
  FROM calls
  WHERE duration_sec > 0
)
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', s.joined_on) AS cohort,
       COUNT(*) AS subscribers,
       COUNT(a.subscriber_id) AS retained,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(a.subscriber_id) / COUNT(*), 1) AS retention_pct
FROM subscribers s
LEFT JOIN active a
  ON a.subscriber_id = s.id
 AND a.m = date(s.joined_on, 'start of month', '+1 month')
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', s.joined_on)
ORDER BY cohort

Namunada yanvar kogortasi 3 kishi. Aziz fevralda gaplashgan, Malika martda (kech), Bekzodning fevraldagi qo'ng'irog'i 0 soniya. Natija 1 / 3, ya'ni 33.3.

Tuzoqlar

calls ni DISTINCT siz ulasangiz, Aziz fevraldagi ikki qo'ng'irog'i uchun ikki marta sanaladi va ulush 100 dan ham oshib ketishi mumkin.

Oy raqamiga bir qo'shish dekabrda buziladi: 13-oy yo'q, yanvar esa boshqa yilda. Oy boshiga INTERVAL '1 month' (yoki '+1 month') qo'shish bu muammoni bilmaydi.

"Keyingi oy" va "keyingi 30 kun" har xil narsa. 30-yanvarda ulangan Kamola 2-martda qo'ng'iroq qilgan: 30 kun ichida, lekin fevralda emas.

Dialektlar farqi

PostgreSQL'da DATE_TRUNC sanani vaqtga aylantiradi, TO_CHAR esa uni matnga. SQLite'da sanalar matn bo'lib qoladi va date() ham matn qaytaradi: '2024-02-01'. Ikkala holatda ham bir xil oyning boshi bir xil qiymat beradi, shuning uchun tenglik bilan ulash ishlaydi.
